about: Pass 7 batch E (2026-10-09): authors' own comparator measurements for the 22 image / text-to-speech / video sources in lone-batch-E.json (63 own-model results alone in their runs). Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. Rule applied: only cells the document shows to be the authors' own measurement (explicit statement, per-cell marker, or the lab's own other models in the same table); cells cited to other papers, matching other makers' published figures, or shown only in images were not used. Result: 9 rows (all by: lab) from 3 sources plus 1 comparison-only model (dots-tts-base); no new ledger entries (rows reuse each source's existing ledger id; scope notes are in the .md). Simulated with lib/score.ts toCells on data/ + these rows: 3 of the 63 lone results start counting (dots-tts-soar seed-tts-en-whisper-v3-wer and seed-tts-zh-paraformer-cer; hidream-o1-image dpg-bench) and 2 new 2-model dots.tts SIM runs count; the 2 Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base rows give their runs 2 models but those tests stay below the scorer's 3-model minimum. Import of models+results into a scratch copy and scripts/check.ts --validate-only pass. held_for_owner (not part of results/models) lists ready options that need a decision, incl. a Kandinsky 2.0 row + model, new-benchmark candidates (CEdit-Bench, OmniContext, Seed-TTS ERes2Net SIM), the Vapi June export, the Wan-Bench table image and LEMAS derived means.
